"""Run the submission inside public_child.py's real rlimit+seccomp child."""
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time

SITE = '/workspace/site'
BOOTSTRAP = pathlib.Path('/workspace/public_child.py').read_text()

def invoke(data, scratch, timeout=180):
    env = {'PATH': '/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', 'HOME': scratch, 'LANG': 'C', 'LC_ALL': 'C',
           'TMPDIR': scratch, 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1', 'PYTHONUNBUFFERED': '1',
           'PYTHONHASHSEED': '0', 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1',
           'MKL_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'SYNECDOCHE_SITE': SITE,
           'LD_LIBRARY_PATH': str(pathlib.Path(SITE).parent/'native')}
    entry = '/workspace/submission/run.py'
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', BOOTSTRAP, '0', entry, scratch],
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                         env=env, close_fds=True)
    try:
        out, err = p.communicate(data, timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        p.kill(); out, err = p.communicate()
        return None, out, err, p.returncode
    return p.returncode, out, err, p.returncode

def main():
    which = sys.argv[1]
    scratch = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='sec-')
    if which == 'examples':
        fixtures = json.loads(pathlib.Path('/workspace/examples.json').read_text())
        for case in fixtures:
            data = (case['raw'].encode() if 'raw' in case else json.dumps(case['request'], separators=(',', ':')).encode())
            rc, out, err, _ = invoke(data, scratch)
            ok = False
            try:
                answer = json.loads(out)
                ok = json.dumps(answer, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(case['response'], sort_keys=True)
            except Exception as e:
                print('bad json', e, out[:200])
            print(f"{case['name']}: rc={rc} {'MATCH' if ok else 'MISMATCH'} err={err.decode()[:200]}")
    else:
        data = open(which, 'rb').read()
        t = time.time()
        rc, out, err, _ = invoke(data, scratch)
        print('rc', rc, 'secs', round(time.time()-t, 1), 'stdout', len(out), 'err', err.decode()[:300])
        print(out[:200])

main()
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 /tmp/seccomp_run.py examples
